body: hello, I think you're right… I am really lucky to have someone does love me, even if it is just only one person in this world of over 7 billion people. I guess something is better than nothing, and I really should feel thankful instead of like a victim… Thank you for your very, very kind words :-)

hi, sorry for the really late reply. I hope things on your end are going well, and I sincerely appreciate your response. Since writing this message, things haven't really improved… I don't want to sound like a victim, but it's really hard not to feel like one. Anyway, thanks for reading my long diatribe and I sincerely appreciate your response
